data.name: Dino Station
data.detailed_description:
You’re a fresh graduate from the Interplanetary Management Academy.
Your first assignment? A forgotten planet full of dinosaurs, a tiny village, and a pile of chores waiting for you.

Your mission is to build a base, set up production, and turn this world into a profitable investment for the company.

Help the locals, study the technology left by past settlers, and use dinosaur DNA to create an automated farming system.

You’re assisted by Kelp-03, a service robot who knows almost everything — and will only share information if you don’t piss him off.

Kelp-03:
“Oh, the red button? Countdown to an explosion? Alright, guess I’m flying off then…”

Features

Alien Dino Farm
Repair old machinery and build new tools — from dinosaur feeding stations to a nano-plant synthesizer. Automate resource collection and watch the base come to life.

Tame and Grow Dinosaurs
Scan wild dinos, clone them, and raise your own! Each dinosaur has unique habits and needs. Feed them well, and they’ll happily help with your work.

Co-op for up to 4 Players
Team up with friends, explore the planet, and build a shared base together.

Vibrant Biomes
Rumor says someone spotted a leviathan skeleton on the shore… or maybe it was something else? Explore a colorful ancient world full of new dinosaurs, plants, and resources in every region.

Local Inhabitants
The settlers here aren’t just neighbors — they’re travelers from every corner of the galaxy. Complete quests, learn their stories, and unlock new storyline missions.

Gameplay

  • Scan dinosaurs and collect their DNA

  • Clone creatures and take care of them

  • Create and grow plants with the synthesizer

  • Complete quests for local settlers

  • Expand your station and unlock new areas

You’re not a hero.
Just a random alien with an old station, a dinosaur scanner, and a clumsy robot…
But you might just surprise everyone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements can´t cover all possible system configurations so issues could occur that influence the functionality in some cases.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements can´t cover all possible system configurations so issues could occur that influence the functionality in some cases.
